scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
